about_app_description: Discover Kazakhstan’s culture and history with Sayahat.
about_description: Sayahat App is a mobile guide to historical, cultural and religious sites across Kazakhstan.
feature_map_desc: View all tourist locations on the map, search any city and open details instantly.
feature_info_desc: History, description, rules and verified data from official sources.
feature_route_desc: Walking and driving routes with closest reachable point detection.
feature_lang_desc: All content available in Kazakh, Russian and English.
feature_extra_desc: Push notifications and automatic nearby place detection.
audio_desc: Professionally narrated audio content in 3 languages.
howto_step1: Open the app and choose your language.
howto_step2: Browse nearby locations on the map.
howto_step3: Tap any place to read the description or listen to the audio guide.
howto_step4: Select route type: walking or driving.
howto_step5: Start navigation and enjoy exploring Kazakhstan.
onboard_title_1: SkillSwap is a platform where people exchange skills
onboard_desc_1: You can teach what you know and learn what you need from others.
onboard_desc_2: For every hour you teach, you earn one hour to learn another skill.
onboard_title_3: Choose how you want to participate
onboard_desc_3: Switch between Teach to share your skills or Learn to find people who can help you grow.
onboard_desc_4: Build experience, gain new skills, and become part of a learning community.

getting_started: Welcome to SkillSwap! This guide will help you navigate the platform and get the most out of your learning and teaching experience.
step_complete_profile: Complete your profile with accurate information
step_add_skills: Add the skills you can teach and want to learn
step_select_skill: Select the skill you want to teach from your profile
step_set_level: Set your proficiency level (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced)
step_wait_request: Wait for interested learners to send requests
step_search_skill: Search for the skill you want to learn in the Skills section
step_view_teacher: View available teachers and their profiles
step_send_request: Send a learning request to a teacher
step_accept_request: Teachers accept requests and learners confirm participation
step_start_chat: Begin chatting to discuss availability and learning goals
step_start_balance: Everyone starts with an initial learning credit
step_earn_time: Earn time by teaching - each hour taught = 1 hour credit earned
step_spend_time: Spend time by learning - each hour learned = 1 hour credit spent
step_after_lesson: After completing a lesson, rate your partner
step_rate_user: Leave a rating based on their teaching or learning quality
step_leave_feedback: Write a brief review to help others learn about your experience
community_guidelines: Be respectful and honest with all community members. Punctuality is important - inform your partner if you need to reschedule. Keep conversations focused on learning and skill sharing. Report any inappropriate behavior to our support team.

intro_text: Welcome to SkillSwap. We value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when using our app.
info_text: We collect information you provide when creating an account, updating your profile, and listing skills to teach or learn. This includes your name, email address, profile picture, and in-app communication.
use_text: The information collected is used to match you with other users, manage your account, improve our services, and send updates.
share_text: SkillSwap does not sell your personal data. We may share public profile information (such as name and skills) with other users for skill exchange purposes.
security_text: We use security measures to protect your data, but no internet transmission can be guaranteed 100% secure.
rights_text: You can access, update, or delete your account data at any time through the app settings.
